description: NORO-REBASE-01: the canonical posting cell replayed at paired seeds 8105/8106 on the post-#724 engine across all four real hulls (expedition, classic, spirit, mega) at their declared complements and both canonical voyage lengths (168/288 epochs, hours clock). The cell is the FLUSH-S4 `off`-arm configuration verbatim -- dose_adjustment 4.0, syndromic_comp65, the reportable boarding rung, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, flush off, cabin_compartment, airflow pool transport -- so the post-724 deltas pair voyage-for-voyage against the flush_sweep_v1_off_s4 archive for expedition/classic/spirit and record mega's first declared-complement reading in this cell. The cabin-fomite channel (PR #721) and crew watch schedules (PR #723) are live at shipped defaults; secretor-negative fraction 0.2 is live in the norwalk_gi profile (NORO-SUSCEPT-04). Nothing is calibrated to an anchor; dose figures stay void pending refit. Readout: score_anchors A1/A2/A4/A5/A8/A9 per hull x length.

fl_exp_7d.description: Declared-complement posting cell on the post-#724 engine: this hull's own layout and complement under the shipped kernel, the reportable boarding rung, sanitary_visit_mode dwell_weighted, flush_aerosol_fraction off and the cabin-compartment/pool-transport settings of the FLUSH-S4 `off` arm it replays voyage-for-voyage at paired seeds 8105/8106. Posting frequency and attack rate are readable because the complement is the hull's own; the cabin-fomite channel and crew watch schedules land on the engine defaults, untouched by this cell's overrides.
